name: Greasus Goldtooth
canonNotes: Tradelord and Overtyrant of the Ogre Kingdoms, a son of the Goldtooth tribe's Tyrant Gofg who killed and ate his own father to take power.
Now older, larger and richer than ever; everything has a price, and trade and tribute are his language.
voiceNotes: Greedy, jovial and domineering; talks of gold, feasts and deals.
Always bargaining; bullies the weak, flatters the rich.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
